# Ikast-Brande

Ikast-Brande is a Danish municipality (*kommune*) named as part of "Sundhedsklynge Kommune" — the health cluster grouping — in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), a national quality-improvement initiative addressing atrial fibrillation care in Denmark [^src1]. The mention appears within a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (structured patient education) of the AFDK program, which is administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram and includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the program [^src1].

The corpus provides no further detail on Ikast-Brande beyond its listing as a participating municipality. No relationships, claims, or timeline events are documented for this entity.
